results.title: Muhimman jihohin Amurka da za'a fafata a zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adin mulki
results.content: Miliyoyin Amurkawa ne ke shirin kaɗa ƙuri’a yau Talata a zaɓen tsakiyar wa’adin wanda bisa al’ada ke sauya jagorancin majalisa, sai dai a wannan karon akwai shakku lura da yadda ƙuri’ar jin ra’ayin jama’a ke nuna cewa Demokrat ba za ta iya tasirin kamar yadda aka yi hasashe ba, musamman koma bayan da ta gani a ranar ƙarshe ta yaƙin neman zaɓe inda Sanata Haley Stevens ta goyi bayan jam’iyyar adawa don ƙalubalantar ɗan takarar jam’iyyarta Abdul El-Sayed a Michigan.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Tabbas Najeriya na fuskantar ƙalubale - Bola Tinubu
results.content: Shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu ya ce tabbas ƙasar na fuskantar kalubale da dama, amma da ƙarfin Allah za'a shawo kan su, muddin aka sake ba shi damar jagorancin ƙasar.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Ƴan bindiga sun ƙwace bindigogin sojoji a Filato bayan kashe soja
results.content: Wasu ƴan bindiga a jihar Filato dake Najeriya sun kai hari wurin binciken ababan hawan soji dake ƙaramar hukumar Riyom, inda suka hallaka soja guda da kuma karɓe makamai guda biyu.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: An cika shekaru 13 da kisan da ƴan ta'adda suka yi wa ƴan jaridar RFI a Mali
results.content: An cika shekaru 13 cif da kisan da ƴan ta’adda suka yi wa wasu ƴan jarida 2 ma’aikatan RFI sashen Faransanci a Mali lokacin da suke tsaka da gudanar da aikinsu na jarida a arewacin ƙasar mai fama da matsalolin tsaro.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Faransa ta yi shelar ware Euro biliyan huɗu don biyan bukatun ɗalibai
results.content: Ɗalibai a Faransa sun sake komawa zanga-zangar adawa bayan kammala hutun makonni biyu, inda suke cigaba da nuna rashin gamsuwa da matakan Gwamnatin ƙasar kan matsalolin ilimi da tsadar rayuwa.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Ƴan Najeriya na aikewa da saƙon taya murna ga Sultan Abubakar
results.content: Ƴan Najeriya na ci gaba da aikewa da saƙon taya murna ga Mai Alfarma Sarkin Musulmin Najeriya Muhamad Sa’ad Abubakar III saboda cika shekaru 20 a ƙaragar mulki.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Dakarun Najeriya sun kashe ƴan ta'adda 34 a yankin Tafkin Chadi
results.content: Dakarun Najeriya na Operation Hadin Kai mai yaki da ta’addanci a yankin arewa maso gabashin ƙasar sun kashe ƴan ta’adda 34 a wasu hare-hare da suka kai Tafkin Chadi a makon da ya gabata.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Iran ta yi tayin buɗe Mashigin Hormuz a cikin ƙwanaki biyu bisa sharaɗi
results.content: Iran ta yiwa Amurka tayin buɗe mashigin ruwan Hormuz nan da ƙwanaki biyu bisa wasu sharuɗɗa.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: An kaddamar da shirin samar da Bankin makamashi na Afirka a Abuja
results.content: Gamayyar hukumomin bada rance na Afrika a hukumance sun ware dala biliyan biyar domin kafa bankin makamashi na Afrika.

results.title: Yadda farfaɗowar alaƙa tsakanin Nijar da Aljeriya ya bunƙasa kasuwanci a Agadas
results.content: Rahotanni daga Jammhuriyar Nijar na nuni da cewa, sannu a hankali, harkokin kasuwanci na ci gaba da bunƙasa, musamman daga yankin Agadez, sakamakon farfaɗowar dangantakar ƙasar da maƙwafciyarta Algeria a baya bayan nan.

results.title: Ɗalibai sun ci gaba da zanga-zanga yau Litinin a wasu sassan Faransa
results.content: Ɗaliba a Faransa da suka dawo daga hutun kaka, sun ci gaba da gudanar da zanga-zanga ta hanyar toshe hanyoyin shiga wasu makarantun sakandare don hana gabatar da darasi a yau ɗin nan, lamarin da ke nuna yunƙunrinsu na sake dawo da zanga-zangar da suka gudanar duk da cewa gwamnati ta yi gargaɗi kan hakan.

results.title: Mutane sama da dubu 300 sun tsere daga gidajensu a yammacin Yemen
results.content: Hukumar Kula da Ƙaurar Baƙi ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta ce fiye da mutane dubu 300 ne suka tsere daga gidajensu a yammacin ƙasar Yemen saboda tsananin faɗa.

results.title: Hukumomin Faransa sun kama mutane 770 da suka fito zanga-zangar ƙarshen mako
results.content: Ma’aikatar cikin gida a Faransa ta bayar da tabbacin kame mutanen da yawansu ya haura 770 a zanga-zangar ƙarshen mako, a wani yanayi da ɗaliban da tun farko suka faro wannan bore ke shan alwashin sake cika tituna yau Litinin, don ƙalubalantar gwamnati wadda suka ce ta yi biris da buƙatunsu.

results.title: Sojojin Najeriya sun kashe wasu kwamandojin ƙungiyar ISWAP 4 a jihar Borno
results.content: Sojojin Najeriya da ke aiki a ƙarƙashin Operation Hadin Kai, sun sanar da kashe 4 daga cikin jagororin ƙungiyar ISWAP ciki harda Larabawa 2 da wani kwamanda da kuma mayaƙansu da dama, a yankin ƙaramar hukumar Kukawa ta jihar Borno.

results.title: Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta kawo ƙarshen ayyukan MINURSO a yankin Western Sahara
results.content: Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta sanar da kawo ƙarshen ayyukan MINURSO, wanda ke wanzar da zaman lafiya a yankin Yammacin Sahara da ke iƙirarin cin gashin kansa, bayan kwashe tsawon shekaru 35, sakamakon matakin da kwamitin sulhu na majalisar ya ɗauka na gaza sabunta wa'adin aikinsa.

results.title: An ceto baƙin-haure sama da 130 da ke ƙoƙarin tsallakawaTurai a tekun Mauritania
results.content: Rundunar sojin ruwan Mauritania ta ceto baƙin haure guda 134 a cikin teku lokacin da suke ƙoƙarin tsallakawa zuwa tsibirin Canary na ƙasar Spain.

results.title: Ƴansandan sun kashe sama da ƴan bindiga 30 a artabun da suka yi a jihar Zamfara
results.content: Rundunar ƴansanda ta jihar Zamfara ta tabbatar da kisan yan ta'adda sama da 30 a wani artabu da jami'anta su ka yi da su a yankin ƙaramar hukumar Bukkuyum.
